proposals.evidence: Full *ut-sthita section 1 gives Prakrit uṭṭhiya, Hindi uṭhā “stood up” and Old Marwari ūṭhyo. Dotyali uṭhyo is the matching perfect form, so the inherited participial node 1907 is selected rather than the present stem 1900. The source dental/retroflex notation is retained.
